title: Sectional Curvature Pinching of Two-Step Nilmanifolds
summary: We study the classical problem of sectional curvature pinching in the class of 2-step nilmanifolds, which are necessarily of mixed curvature. We show that the pinching constant of any 2-step nilmanifold lies in the compact interval $[-3, -\frac{3}{2}]$. The upper bound $-\frac{3}{2}$ is achieved by the complex Heisenberg group $\mathrm{Heis}_3(\mathbb{C})$ with a Ricci soliton metric. The upper bound exhibits rigidity: if a simply connected 2-step nilmanifold $N$ has the pinching constant $-\frac{3}{2}$, then $N$ admits a Ricci soliton complex Heisenberg group as a totally geodesic subgroup.…
